title: Concept: Joomla version in generator meta tag
description: The page publishes its Joomla identity, and often its version, in a generator meta tag, so the CMS and its release line are readable.
applicability: Responses rendered by a Joomla site.
risk: The identity narrows the search for applicable core and extension issues; LOW because the tag alone is not an exploit and the site may be patched.
